phase_timings.notes: Checked official ISO, NN/g, Apple HIG, and Microsoft Fluent sources for user-centred design, usability, and accessibility anchors.
Inspected persistent instruction docs and bootstrap manifest as hot anchors for durable future behavior.
Added the user-point-of-view product quality gate to common, Korean, and English persistent instruction docs and bootstrap manifest.
Recorded request summary, work summary, request trace, web search, plan, omission check, evaluation, and timing.

bottleneck_notes: The durable gate can prevent repeated UX drift only if future implementation slices explicitly evaluate user goal, first action, feedback, confusion points, and success evidence.
This change intentionally avoids touching desktop UI source so the current work can be committed as a scoped governance update.
